correctness.rationale: Direct shortest-path enumeration and a complete S_m by S_n sector decomposition yield exact formulas for all powered-distance quadratic directions. Exponential-distance contrast blocks are uniformly positive definite; a Bernstein identity transfers this to strict negativity for all 0<p<1. The two-dimensional mass sector has an explicit H matrix. Schoenberg strict-interior monotonicity proves uniqueness of the unbalanced critical root, while concavity handles the balanced endpoint. The eight-cycle exception and fixed-part asymptotic follow from exact rank and implicit differentiation. Packaged BFS and numerical eigenspectra checks replay with 86 assertion groups, independent of the analytical formulas.

value.rationale: The complete all-parameter result concerns a canonical new-vertex subdivision and a motivated Hilbert-embeddability invariant. It reveals an exact dichotomy: balanced bicliques retain the optimal exponent whereas every asymmetric biclique loses it, with fixed-part exponent vanishing at a new explicit rate even while the unsubdivided exponent stays bounded away from zero. The exact critical kernel and embedding rank make the result useful for quantitative incidence-graph geometry. It is not merely a known-table recomputation, arbitrary slice or a small numerical improvement.
